description: This Java class is an event listener that reacts to failed login attempts due to bad credentials. It retrieves the user by email, increments failed login attempts, and locks the user account if the maximum number of failed attempts is reached.

classes.name: AuthenticationBadCredentialsListener
classes.description: A Spring component that listens for authentication failure events due to bad credentials, and manages user account locking after multiple failed attempts.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles the event of an authentication failure caused by bad credentials. Retrieves the user, increments failed attempts, and locks the account if necessary.
